def A09 : Prop := ∀ {G : Gauge} {L : Register G} {S : Table L} (D : Ward.SpinRows S), Brackets D →
    rel D ∧ ∀ K : Ward.SpinRows S, Brackets K → ∀ d (z : List ℝ) i,
      Commute (wave z (leaf D d) (leaf K d)) (effect (leaf D d i) (leaf K d i))

proof_context.conclusion: `A09` states that for `Brackets` families `D`, `K`, the operator `wave z (leaf D d) (leaf K d)` commutes with `effect (leaf D d i) (leaf K d i)`.

lemma casimir (p : Ind) : Commute (∑ q : Ind, f (Spin.K q)^2) (f (Spin.K p)) := by
  obtain ⟨i,j⟩ := p
  let P (a b : Axis) := f (plane a b)
  let g (a b : Axis) := (if b=i then P a j else 0) - (if b=j then P a i else 0) +
    (if a=i then P j b else 0) - (if a=j then P i b else 0)
  have hg (a b : Axis) : P a b * P i j - P i j * P a b = g a b := by
    dsimp [P]; rw [h, bracket_planes]; simp [P, g, apply_ite f]
  have he (a b : Axis) : P a b^2 * P i j - P i j * P a b^2 = P a b * g a b + g a b * P a b := by
    rw [← hg]; noncomm_ring
  change (∑ q : Ind, P q.1 q.2 ^ 2) * P i j = P i j * (∑ q : Ind, P q.1 q.2 ^ 2)
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  dsimp only
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, he]
  simp [g, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  abel

proof_context.conclusion: `casimir` shows the sum of squares of the relative generators commutes with each one, the antisymmetric structure constants cancelling in pairs.

lemma commutes_evaluate {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℂ X]
    {A B : Spin.End X} (h : Commute A B) (z : List ℝ) : Commute (evaluate z A) B := by
  induction z with
  | nil => exact Commute.zero_left _
  | cons t z ih => exact ((Commute.one_left _).smul_left (t:ℂ)).add_left (h.mul_left ih)

proof_context.conclusion: `commutes_evaluate` passes the commutation from the Casimir to every polynomial `z` of it.

private lemma imaginary {L : Register G} {S : Table L} (d) {X : SpinRows S} {Y : SpinRows (Bel L)} (hu : Brackets X)
    (ht : Brackets Y) (v : Spin.change S d) (z : List ℝ) (i : Spin.Ind) (A : A09) :
    Commute (wave z (transport X v) (leaf Y d)) (effect (transport X v i) (leaf Y d i)) := by
  classical
  -- transport at this cap; pad others default with free.
  let b : Ortho.Skew→ₗ[ℝ] ((Bel L).Field d→ₗ[ℂ] (Bel L).Field d) := {
    toFun t := v.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ ((X d t) ∘ₗ v.toLinearMap)
    map_add' i j := by ext u; simp
    map_smul' a t := by
      apply LinearMap.ext; intro u
      change v.symm (X d (a • t) (v u))=a • v.symm _
      rw [map_smul]; exact (v.symm.toLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ).map_smul a _ }
  let F := update Y d b
  have hf : Brackets F := by
    intro n g k; by_cases h : n=d
    · subst n; unfold F; rw [update_self]; apply LinearMap.ext; intro u
      have he := LinearMap.congr_fun (hu d g k) (v u)
      apply v.injective; simpa [b] using! he -- needs coe rewrites
    rw [show F n=Y n from update_of_ne h ..]; exact ht n g k
  have hp : leaf F d=transport X v := by unfold leaf transport; simp only [F,update_self]; rfl
  rw [← hp]; exact (A F hf).2 Y ht d z i

proof_context.conclusion: `imaginary` applies `A09` to the transported generators `transport X v` and the limit generators `leaf Y d`.

def Tracks (S : AddSubgroup (Mat X)) (p : List ℝ) (C : I → Mat X) (B : I → Mat X) :=
    wave p B C ∈ preserves S ∧ ∀ i, Commute (wave p B C) (effect (B i) (C i))

proof_context.conclusion: `Tracks` records `Commute (wave p B C) (effect (B i) (C i))` for all `i`, together with membership in `preserves S`.
